guides.title: Quoted spread and effective spread use different reference quantities
guides.concept: Quoted spread is contemporaneous offer minus bid; effective spread commonly uses twice the signed execution-price distance from the relevant midpoint.
guides.procedure: Define eligible quote and execution timestamps, calculate midpoint, direction of the trade, and label dollars per share or basis points.
